name: Ironwood Education Limited
about: Ironwood Education Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides vocational education services in India and internationally. The company provides vocational training in the fields of event management, advertising, public relations, journalism, and radio and DJ training under the EMDI Institute of Media & Communication name; sports management courses under the Ironwood Sports Management Global Academy name; and wedding planning trainings under The Wedding Academy name. It also offers professional training, including teaching graduates, undergraduate and working professionals in the field of event management, wedding planning, and radio jockey and programming through classroom training and workshops. The company was formerly known as Greycells Education Limited and changed its name to Ironwood Education Limited in March 2021. Ironwood Education Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.
